summary.notes: The pack does not support one stronger cross-bundle authorization claim. Two limited links survive review: `agent-a2-f008` and `agent-c-anom_13` are the same unresolved `admin_post_backwpup_support` signal at `inc/class-admin.php:1177`, and `agent-a2-f001` plus `agent-d-cg-002` share a bare `wp_ajax_*` registration style in `inc/class-admin.php:281-296`. That link stops at guard-model similarity: `agent-a2-f002` is gated by `check_admin_referer()` and `current_user_can( 'backwpup' )` at `inc/class-admin.php:849-852` before reaching the onboarding write sink, and the download path inherits capability enforcement through `inc/class-destinations.php:147-184` and `inc/class-destination-downloader.php:109-110`.

suggested_actions.reason: `wp_ajax_backwpup_debug_info` directly emits debug information at `inc/class-admin.php:281-290` without a visible capability check in the hook body, but that disclosure path does not depend on the download or admin-post flows.

The common `file_download()` implementation at `inc/class-destinations.php:147-184` routes the AJAX request into a download handler and then into `download_by_chunks()`, which calls `ensure_user_can_download()` at `inc/class-destination-downloader.php:109-110`. That refutes a stronger `missing_authentication_ajax_handler` reading for this cluster.

Only the hook registration to `BackWPup_Pro_Page_Support::save_post_form` is visible at `inc/class-admin.php:1177`; the target handler implementation is not present in the local source reviewed for this cluster.
This is the same unresolved `admin_post_backwpup_support` signal as `agent-a2-f008`, and the missing target handler means the cluster cannot promote it beyond an unresolved entry-point observation.

The `admin_post_backwpup` route is a guarded counterexample, not evidence of a shared missing-auth pattern: `save_post_form()` enforces `check_admin_referer( $post_page . '_page' )` and `current_user_can( 'backwpup' )` at `inc/class-admin.php:849-852` before dispatching to `BackWPup_Page_Onboarding::save_post_form()` at `inc/class-admin.php:892-894`.

proposed_links.reason: Both findings are anchored to the same `admin_post_backwpup_support` registration at `inc/class-admin.php:1177`, so they describe one unresolved handler, not two independent issues.

Both AJAX endpoints are registered in `inc/class-admin.php:281-296` without an immediate nonce or capability check at the hook site. The similarity stops there because the download path has downstream capability enforcement while the debug-info closure does not show one in the pack.

objections.reason: The out-of-band validation in `inc/class-destinations.php:147-184` shows the download path reaches `download_by_chunks()`, and that method immediately calls `ensure_user_can_download()` at `inc/class-destination-downloader.php:109-110`. This is a concrete refutation attempt that succeeded.

The onboarding write sink at `inc/class-page-onboarding.php:127` is reached only after the `admin_post_backwpup` handler performs both nonce and capability checks at `inc/class-admin.php:849-852`, so it does not materially reinforce the cluster's missing-guard theme.

Joining the support-hook reports with the other members would be speculative because the actual `BackWPup_Pro_Page_Support::save_post_form` implementation is not available in the bounded evidence set or local source tree.
